limiterDetail: Main limiter: rain, plus evening wind on the south grounds. Showers before dawn (0.7–2.0 mm/h from 3–5 AM) have eased to ≤0.4 mm/h now. They come back from mid-afternoon, ~14.4 mm for the day. Wind is light on the north and east grounds all day (≤8.5 kt), but Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Nangalao build to 14–17 kt from ~6–9 PM. Currents are favorable on most grounds. Tara and Turda run 0.7–1.2 kt from ~7 AM to midnight.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Today (Wed 14) dropped from GOOD to MARGINAL. ECMWF now has today much wetter (~14.4 mm, was ~6.7). Wind is actually lighter (7.2 kt, gusts ~12, was 9.7 / 16). Fishermen activity today drops from HIGH to REDUCED.

Supply for the next 48h is downgraded. Thu 15 goes from ABOVE NORMAL to NORMAL, softening , because there's no strong Wednesday catch to cushion it. Fri 16 is the thinnest point. Shortage risk now runs Wed → Tue 20 (was Thu → Mon).

The weekend got better. Sat 17 is upgraded to GOOD (8.9 kt, ~4.6 mm) and Mon 19 is upgraded to GOOD and is now the best day (4.9 kt, ~1.8 mm), so the 3-day outlook rises from softening to ABOVE NORMAL from late Sat. Thu 15 is the worst day again (11 kt, gusts 20, ~14.5 mm). Fri 16 is much drier (4.0 mm, was 14.5) but still MARGINAL on wind (11 kt, gusts 18).
